entities.name: Omenpath Arc
entities.description: The one-year storyline about the aftermath of the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Desparkening, the opening of the Omenpaths and Kellan; first part of the Metronome arc.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion whose aftermath the arc deals with.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event whose consequences the arc deals with.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Paths between planes that open in the arc, used by Kellan to travel.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Non-planeswalker, half-fae, half-human son of Oko who travels via Omenpaths in search of his father.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who secretly features in the arc masquerading as Ashiok, plotting to recreate the multiverse.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker who secretly takes part in the plot to recreate the multiverse.

entities.name: Coin Empire
entities.description: Empire whose technology and remnants are used in the plot.

entities.name: Metronome
entities.description: Three-year story arc of which the Omenpath Arc is the first part.

entities.name: Dragonstorm Arc
entities.description: Arc that continues the Metronome storyline.
